instagram.caption:
The grout you cannot clean.
The Shower or Tub in the Guest Bathroom. It has to be ready for someone to shower in tonight, even though nobody has used it since spring.

What done looks like:
1. Three bottles in the caddy
2. More than a third full
3. A curtain liner or glass screen with no pink film along the bottom edge
4. A bath mat folded over the tub rim rather than lying wet on the floor

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success shower or tub.
